title: olusatrum
intro: Olusatrum, commonly known as sea purslane, is a succulent, salt-tolerant plant that thrives in coastal and estuarine environments. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Olusatrum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects, which make it a potential treatment for various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of Olusatrum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
